svg.aria-label: A Q4_K super-block: 256 weights in eight sub-blocks of 32, each sub-block with its own 6-bit scale and 6-bit minimum packed into a twelve-byte plane whose bits are split across a different byte than where the field appears to live, plus two 16-bit values d and dmin shared by the whole super-block, for 144 bytes or 4.5 bits per weight.
svg.text: ONE Q4_K SUPER-BLOCK: 256 WEIGHTS, EIGHT SCALE PAIRS, TWELVE PACKED BYTES
the super-block, as the kernel sees it
each sub-block has its own step d*sc and offset dmin*m,
so one outlier spoils 32 weights, not 256.
the twelve scale bytes, bit by bit
A-D, a-d: scales and mins 0-3, low six bits
E-H, e-h: scales and mins 4-7, HIGH two bits, in bytes 0-7
bytes 8-11: scales 4-7 and mins 4-7, low four bits
so sub-block 5 lives in bytes 5, 9 and 1 - three places
12 B scales + 2 B d + 2 B dmin + 128 B nibbles = 144 B for 256 weights
payload 4 bits, description 0.5 bits - for sixteen numbers, not eight
Q4_0 spends the same 0.5 bits on eight f16 scales; the 6-bit packing is what buys the mins.
